prompts.name: keepsake-story-v1
prompts.prompt: Create a transparent 3:2 landscape keepsake illustration for English Lesson21–22, matching IMAGE ONE's approved simple chibi graphic style EXACTLY: thick uniform cocoa outlines, oversized rounded heads, tiny dark dots or simple curved eyes (NO white eyeballs), blush circles, simple smiles, chunky hands, flat soft colors, few hair clumps and folds. Images TWO and THREE are identity references, not line-style references. Man on LEFT: short greying hair parted to side, round brown glasses, small moustache, sage waistcoat over cream shirt, dark grey-green trousers. Jane on RIGHT: brown SIDE ponytail, slightly longer face, dusty rose tunic-dress with distinctive white pointed collar. They are facing each other. Close waist-up view with large readable faces and hands. The man now holds exactly ONE plain RED book with ivory page edge at his chest in one hand, looking gratefully to Jane. Jane has finished handing it over: both hands EMPTY, relaxed and natural; friendly smile. No duplicate book, no other items, no background, no text/names/numbers/stars, no frames. Keep heads, hands and book completely inside canvas with clear transparent margin. This is a book handover, not a handbag scene; no copied people or props from image one.

prompts.name: cast-ready-v1
prompts.prompt: Use this approved reference as EXACT simple chibi character and style model: thick dark cocoa outlines, large rounded heads, tiny dot/curved eyes, simple smiles, NO white eyeballs (round glasses on man are okay), flat soft colors, minimal details. Man LEFT with grey side-parted hair, round glasses, moustache, cream shirt sage waistcoat and grey-green trousers. Jane RIGHT with brown SIDE ponytail, dusty rose tunic dress, white pointed collar, dark leggings and brown shoes. Full-body stage illustration, heads hair hands shoes entirely inside canvas with transparent margins, both facing each other. Landscape 3:2, genuine transparent background, no text, stars, frames or scenery. Both people standing EMPTY-HANDED, man making a mild request, Jane listening thoughtfully. Between them a LOW simple book table at knee height with exactly TWO separate closed books: ONE plain red and ONE plain muted beige. Neither book highlighted, both equally visible. This is before she picks up anything. No floating or duplicate books.
